                    [32m'import { SubscribePropsWithStore, SubscribeSource } from "./Subscribe.js";\n'[39m +

                    [32m'//#region src/useTable.d.ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m"type ReactTable<TFeatures extends TableFeatures, TData extends RowData, TSelected = TableState<TFeatures>> = Omit<Table<TFeatures, TData>, 'store'> & {\n"[39m +
                    [32m'  /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * @deprecated Prefer `table.state` for render reads,\n'[39m +

                    [32m'   * subscriptions. `table.store.state` is a current-value snapshot and is easy\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * to misuse in render code.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   */\n'[39m +
                    [32m"  readonly store: Table<TFeatures, TData>['store'];\n"[39m +
                    [32m'  /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * A React HOC (Higher Order Component) that allows you to subscribe to the table state.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * This is useful for opting into state re-renders for specific parts of the table state.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * Pass `source` to subscribe to a single atom or store (e.g. `table.atoms.rowSelection`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * or `table.optionsStore`) instead of the full `table.store`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * @example\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * <table.Subscribe selector={(state) => ({ rowSelection: state.rowSelection })}>\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   *   {({ rowSelection }) => (\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   *     <tr key={row.id}>...</tr>\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   *   )}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * </table.Subscribe>\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * @example\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * <table.Subscribe source={table.atoms.rowSelection}>\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   *   {(rowSelection) => <div>...</div>}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * </table.Subscribe>\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'   * @example\n'[39m +

                    [32m'      selector?: undefined;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'      children: ((state: TSourceValue) => ReactNode) | ReactNode;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    }): ReturnType<FunctionComponent>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    <TSourceValue, TSubSelected>(props: {\n'[39m +

                    [32m'      selector: (state: TSourceValue) => TSubSelected;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'      children: ((state: TSubSelected) => ReactNode) | ReactNode;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    }): ReturnType<FunctionComponent>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m"    <TSubSelected>(props: Omit<SubscribePropsWithStore<TFeatures, TSubSelected>, 'source'>): ReturnType<FunctionComponent>;\n"[39m +
                    [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  /**\n'[39m +

                    [32m'   */\n'[39m +

                    [32m'};\n'[39m +

                content: [32m"import React, { useState, useMemo, createContext, useContext } from 'react';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'import {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  useTable,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  createCoreRowModel,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  flexRender,\n'[39m +
                  [32m"} from '@tanstack/react-table';\n"[39m +
                  [32m"import { useForm } from '@tanstack/react-form';\n"[39m +
                  [32m"import './App.css';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'interface User {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  id: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  name: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  email: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  role: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const FormContext = createContext<any>(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'interface EditRowWrapperProps {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  row: any;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  onSave: (values: { name: string; email: string; role: string }) => void;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const EditRowWrapper: React.FC<EditRowWrapperProps> = ({ row, onSave }) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const form = useForm({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    defaultValues: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      name: row.original.name,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      email: row.original.email,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      role: row.original.role,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      onSave(value);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    <FormContext.Provider value={form}>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      <tr className="bg-purple-50/40 dark:bg-purple-950/20 border-b border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/50 transition-colors">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell: any) => (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          <td\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            key={cell.id}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 align-middle"\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          >\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            {flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          </td>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        ))}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      </tr>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    </FormContext.Provider>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  );\n'[39m +
                  [32m'};\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export default function App() {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const [data, setData] = useState<User[]>([\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    { id: '1', name: 'Alice Smith', email: 'alice@example.com', role: 'Admin' },\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    { id: '2', name: 'Bob Jones', email: 'bob@example.com', role: 'User' },\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    { id: '3', name: 'Charlie Brown', email: 'charlie@example.com', role: 'Editor' },\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  ]);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleEdit = (user: User) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setEditingId(user.id);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleCancel = () => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setEditingId(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleSave = (updatedValues: { name: string; email: string; role: string }) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setData((prev) =>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      prev.map((user) =>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        user.id === editingId ? { ...user, ...updatedValues } : user\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      )\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    );\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setEditingId(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const columns = useMemo(\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    () => [\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"        accessorKey: 'id',\n"[39m +
                  [32m'        header: () => <span className="text-left block">ID</span>,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        cell: ({ getValue }: any) => (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          <span className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 block text-left">\n'[39m +

            [32m'IMPORTANT: This tool is for terminal operations like git, npm, docker, etc. DO NOT use it for file operations (reading, writing, editing, searching, finding files) - use the specialized tools for this instead.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Before executing the command, please follow these steps:\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'# Committing changes with git\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'Git Safety Protocol:\n'[39m +

Taking unauthorized destructive actions is unhelpful and can result in lost work, so it's best to ONLY run these commands when given direct instructions \n"[39m +
